# OpenApiConnector

A connector to one HTTP endpoint: its method, URL, parameters and request and response schemas.

**Kind:** an object, used in responses.

## Fields

Every field is present in a response; empty ones are `null`.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `versions` | [`OpenApiConnectorVersion`](open-api-connector-version.md)`[]` | Every version of the connector, oldest first. |
| `name` | `string` | The connector's name, unique within its namespace. |
| `namespaceId` | `uuid` | The id of the namespace it belongs to. |
| `tenantId` | `uuid` | The id of the tenant it belongs to. |
| `id` | `uuid` | The unique id. Use it in `by-id` routes and wherever another object refers to this one. |
| `dateCreated` | `datetime` | When it was created, in UTC. |
| `dateUpdated` | `datetime` | When it was last changed, in UTC. |

## Example

```json
{
  "versions": [
    {
      "httpMethod": "...",
      "pathParameters": [],
      "queryParameters": [],
      "url": "...",
      "description": "...",
      "requestSchema": "...",
      "responseSchema": "...",
      "postProcessResponseUnicodeCharacters": false,
      "authenticationType": "None",
      "version": 0,
      "date": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z",
      "isDisabled": false
    }
  ],
  "name": "...",
  "namespaceId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "tenantId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "dateCreated": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z",
  "dateUpdated": "2026-10-26T12:00:00.0000000Z"
}
```
